title: Serial Communication
lead: Covers lecture 09 and exercise 7: serial vs parallel, synchronous vs asynchronous, the USART and the asynchronous frame, line drivers and USB interfaces, transmitter and receiver, USART registers, baud rate and baud rate error, systems 16 and 17 (character encloser with polling and interrupts), Arduino Serial, and the temp logger exercise (firmware, stdio streams and the C# .NET application). The peer notes do not cover this lecture. Part 2 adds beginner explanations with diagrams, the temp logger worked through (including the fill-in-the-blanks C code), and what the lecturer explained in the six 2020 serial-communication recordings.
